name: dnp3
title: DNP3: opendnp3 sanitizer + BMC
summary: Sanitizer fuzzing of opendnp3 (C++, the target) on the DNP3 link/transport/application decode path via the public Decoder::DecodeLPDU. A CRC-aware term mutator builds valid link frames (poly 0x3D65) so inputs reach the transport/app parsers, and corrupts CRC/len/ctrl for link robustness. A field-level differential is infeasible — opendnp3 emits parsed fields only as log strings (empty IDecoderCallbacks), and the Rust dnp3 crate has no public decode API and a non-commercial license — so this is a sanitizer + bounded-model-checking target, not a differential one.
